label: full-D07
brief: Deliver this poster in three sizes: 1:1 for a feed post, 9:16 for a story, 16:9 for a banner. Each one must fill its frame: re-lay out the design so the artwork and every word fit the new shape naturally; keep the style, colours and all the lettering exactly; no stretching, and no letterboxing bars.

intent.why: The request reformats an existing poster without introducing factual content.
intent.say: I’ll create square feed, tall story, and wide banner versions, reflowing the artwork and lettering to fill each frame. I’ll preserve the vintage style, colours, and every word, with no stretching or letterboxing.

turns.say: I’ll create square feed, tall story, and wide banner versions, reflowing the artwork and lettering to fill each frame. I’ll preserve the vintage style, colours, and every word, with no stretching or letterboxing.

reflow-1x1.prompt: Recompose the supplied original design as a 1:1 square post. Keep this text exactly as one block, in its original hierarchy: 'A FREE GOVERNMENT SERVICE', 'GRAND CANYON', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'U.S. DEPARTMENT', 'OF THE INTERIOR', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'SERVICE'. Extend or redraw the canyon scenery in the same style to fill the square edge to edge, adding side scenery or sky and foreground as needed. Preserve palette, type style, mood, lighting, and any figures’ identity, pose and clothing. Reposition elements without clipping; never squeeze or stretch. No bars, borders, mount or photo frame: the poster is the whole image.

reflow-9x16.prompt: Re-compose the supplied original design as a tall 9:16 story. Keep these words exactly as one block, in the original hierarchy: 'A FREE GOVERNMENT SERVICE', 'GRAND CANYON', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'U.S. DEPARTMENT', 'OF THE INTERIOR', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'SERVICE'. Extend or redraw the artwork in the same style, adding sky above and canyon scenery and foreground below to fill edge to edge. Preserve palette, type style, mood, lighting, and any depicted identities, poses and clothing. Reposition and scale proportionally to keep everything visible; never squeeze or stretch. No clipping, bars, borders, mount or photo frame: the poster is the whole image.

reflow-16x9.prompt: Use generate_image to re-compose the original design as a wide 16:9 banner. Keep these words exactly as one block, in this order and original hierarchy: 'A FREE GOVERNMENT SERVICE', 'GRAND CANYON', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'U.S. DEPARTMENT', 'OF THE INTERIOR', 'NATIONAL PARK', 'SERVICE'. Extend or redraw the canyon scenery to both sides in the same style, filling the canvas edge to edge. Preserve palette, type style, mood, lighting and any figures’ identity, pose and clothing. Reposition intact elements as needed; never squeeze or stretch. Nothing clipped; no bars, borders, mount or photo frame—the poster is the whole image.
